newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Dividend payments boost Ivory Coast shares.
newsitem.headline: Dividend payments boost Ivory Coast shares.

text.p: Dividend payments helped boost prices on the Ivory Coast Stock Exchange on Friday, the bourse's market report showed.
The rise was also due to prospects of further near-term dividend payments, a trader added.

The all-share index rose 0.86 percent to close at 418.91, up on the previous Friday's 415.35. The 12-VB blue-chip index rose 0.96 percent to 288.65, compared to its rise last week of 2.49 percent to 285.93.

In total this week, 4,909 shares worth 111,099,846 CFA francs were traded compared to 2,128 shares worth of 59,141,090 CFA francs last week. The most active share was banking company SGBCI with 32.78 percent of the volume.
NESTLE-CI, up 3,150 to 61,050, led the risers over the week, followed by tobacco company SITAB, up 2,670 to 46,720, and rubber manufacturer SOGB, which rose 1,780 to 19,280.
The decliners were financial institutions SAFCA, down 880 at 22,550, and the banking company BICICI, down 780 to 38,220.
